facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services reported on 4 September 2025 that its leadership estimated a budget for the operations of the Access to Information Commission, which it calls a parastatal facing operating challenges; the amount was not given and the budget is estimated, not voted.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services

note: The document names no law, its year or any draft, so no standing fact; the Universal Service and Access Fund is not an access to information system.
